summary: Port canonical additive retrieval scoring to web; end web/pipeline scoring divergence

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Grounded in guru/retriever.py (canonical pipeline retriever) + export.py. Decision: port the pipeline's additive model rather than invent RRF or a calibrated multiplicative formula. Formula: score = 0.7*sim + 0.3*max(tierW, graphScore) + diversity. Weights HARDCODED to pipeline defaults (user decision): vector_weight=0.7, graph_weight=0.3, tier verified/proposed/inferred = 1.0/0.7/0.4, diversity_boost=0.1, max_per_tradition=3. Vector hits get explicit tier='inferred' (fixes 3251a8d6 silent-0.4). Graph leg contributes via graph_weight*max(tierW,graphScore), an independent additive term — no fake 0.5 distance (fixes 0a771923). Diversity gets a hard per-tradition cap + a rarity-aware first-pass boost, going beyond canonical which is still first-seen (fixes ce844add). No edge weights used: corpus has none.
